condition.external_actions: no input, GUI activation, app launch, capture, network, or model call
mutex_checks: contender times out while parent owns mutex
child owns mutex and exits without releasing; parent observes WAIT_ABANDONED
condition.mutex_names: ephemeral UUID suffixes under Local namespace
condition.processes: fresh same-user Python subprocesses in current Windows session

decision_rule: All three mutex state results must match expected wait semantics, and two namespace digests must match. WAIT_ABANDONED establishes process-owner death only; do not infer operation resolution or clear UNKNOWN without a durable custody journal.
purpose: Verify that the R33 Windows logon namespace digest is stable across separate processes and that a Local named mutex serializes same-session processes and signals owner-process death as WAIT_ABANDONED.
scope: Same-user/current Windows logon only; no cross-logon uniqueness, no actual input, no late-input or task-effect claim.
stop_rule: One orchestrated run with the registered two namespace reads and mutex cases; no retry.
